title: Nonlinear Stability of the Full Kerr Family
exact_target: Show that small perturbations of rotating black holes keep a complete exterior and settle to another Kerr black hole.

status_qualification: The primary formulation also requires a nonempty black-hole region and sufficiently fast asymptotic approach in the exterior. Smallness norm and decay topology are intentionally rough in the report. The ordinary subextremal stability target should not silently be enlarged to extremal horizons, where different phenomena occur, nor reduced to small angular momentum alone.
